_why: Ratchet floors. A gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement: stripping four required headings from one pack made validate.py drop 1270->1269 and sloplint.py 224->223, both still green. Each number is the count measured on the commit named below. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit.
_measured_on: onionskin, the thirty-fifth pack, 2026-08-25, thirty-five packs and thirty-five kits, clean tree
_raised: 4754/2784/706 -> 4882/2875/720 on the onionskin release, 2026-08-25. One more pack and one more kit through checks that already existed, plus this pack's second theme block — validate_palette.py carries a [data-surface] map as well as :root, which is why its delta (+91) is larger than a single-theme pack's. computed_at_least rises 600 -> 628. Both ratio ceilings held for the third consecutive release. | 2026-08-26, B-115: components_unanswered_at_most LOWERED 9 -> 6 with three answers, not with a reason to skip them — `roster`'s inputs (two shapes, measured), loaders (none: the page's three perpetual animations are ebook floats) and empty states (none: three forms and no data surface). Lowering a ratchet is the only direction that needs no argument.
_not_raised_by_the_widening: Measured old-pattern-against-new on one tree: the widened separator adds 51 spans across all 1025 text files but only 2 inside the source list validate_counted_claims reads, which is why the floor moves by 2 and not by 51. The rest are in CHANGELOG.md, docs/audit/, docs/evidence/ and test/*.py -- historical narration ('the ten-heading contract', 'a nine-heading pack') plus one branch name, 3 of which the identifier exemption drops. Adding any of those files to the source list means adjudicating each span, not adding a regex escape.

validate_palette.py:ratios._why: Measured on the B-013 close, 2026-08-20: 513 stated ratios — 348 computed, 15 naming a partner this pack cannot pair, 150 reaching no check (0 in a table declaring no base, 10 at a gradient stop, 140 prose). Before it the line said 336 guarded, of which 15 had never been through the arithmetic: the tally was incremented before the pairs were computed. The 27 table claims were closed by declaring the base each table's own numbers resolve against — atrium/router/orchard on `--bg`, cyclorama on `--ink` with four cells naming `--field-2` — every one confirmed by computing it, none of them invented. Unchanged by the B-017 close: the declared-set check adds no ratio claims, and the three pinned figures were re-measured at 348/15/150 after it landed. Raised to 349 on the B-048 close: `scoreboard`'s secondary button now STATES the ratio it renders (`--ink-soft` at 4.55:1 on `--surface-2`) instead of an alpha instruction nothing computed. Correcting the spec had first moved the pair out of every check — the same trap as B-017, where fixing a false distinctness claim removed the only thing making the pair observable, so the claim is stated in the form the gate reads. Raised to 353 on the B-050 close: `maquette` gained `--on-model` with its ratio stated, and `prism`'s `$` prompt now states 4.70:1 on `--surface-2` instead of using a token its own layer calls furniture. A fourth new claim had to be rewritten because 'on' and its token landed on either side of a line break — the same refusal B-039's fix met, and correctly. Then the B-003 pass, 2026-08-20: 353 -> 448 computed and 150 -> 57 unguarded. One hypothesis was tested against all 140 prose claims — 'this ratio is against the pack's own field' — and 88 of them agreed with it arithmetically, on 77 lines. Those lines now name `--bg` instead of saying 'on the field' or naming nothing, which is more precise prose, not less. Four of the 77 went red on the first run and each was a real find: editing a line where ONE claim resolved put its neighbours under the arithmetic too, and `blueprint`'s `3:1` was a floor whose word 'floor' had wrapped, `proscenium`'s subject was the words 'Body ink', `tenor`'s subject sat on the previous line. The 52 that did not agree were left alone. Raised to 452 on the atrium widening — and the first attempt wrote 453, an estimate rather than a count, which this ratchet refused in the same breath: five ratios stated in `## Components`, each naming its partner on one line. `--accent` at 4.17:1 on `--surface` is the one an implementer needed and no section had ever said: the accent is safe on `--bg` and on `--ink`, and not on the cream card. | Raised 2026-08-20 (B-053): the broad pairing pass had been UNREACHABLE behind a `continue` since it was written — 29 lines reading as a live check that had never run. Enabled for prose after adjudicating the nine lines it fails on: three are out of scope by construction and are named in ARGUED, two were an indented table misread as prose (`line.startswith('|')` does not see a leading space), four were wrong writing and are fixed in the packs. Coverage went 456 computed / 57 unguarded / 46 prose to 457 computed + 31 verified by the broad pass / 23 unguarded / 6 prose. | Raised 2026-08-21 for the `outrank` pack, the library's thirtieth: computed 457 -> 491 (+34, the pack states and the gate computes them), unresolved 15 -> 19 and unguarded 26. The four new unresolved figures are all the same shape and it is a permanent one: a pack that documents what it REFUSED carries ratios whose subject it deliberately does not ship — the reference's eyebrow #64748b at 4.37:1 on --surface and its warning #ff642d at 2.95:1, both corrected in the layer. Naming a partner the pack cannot pair is the honest bucket for those, and the alternative is deleting the evidence for a correction. | Raised 2026-08-21 for `babylove`, the thirty-first pack: computed 491 -> 518 (+27) and unresolved 19 -> 22. The three new unresolved figures are the same permanent shape as outrank's four — a pack that documents what it REFUSED carries ratios whose subject it deliberately does not ship, here Tailwind's gray-400 #99a1af at 2.60:1 and 2.49:1, corrected to gray-500 in the layer. Deleting the evidence for a correction is the alternative. | Raised 2026-08-22 for `patchbay`, the thirty-second pack: computed 518 -> 536 (+18), unresolved 22 -> 25 (+3) and unguarded 26 -> 27 (+1). The three new unresolved figures are the permanent shape this gate documents in its own comment — 'the subject is a composite or an alpha' — and they are the three alpha tokens whose ratio carries an OBLIGATION rather than a description: --hairline at 1.25:1 and --wash at 1.06:1 say why nothing may be written on them, and --accent-rim at 3.10:1 is the primary button's only visible edge and clears the 3:1 boundary floor by 0.10. Five more alpha tokens were written WITHOUT a ratio in the same layer, because for a tint the alpha is the specification and the ratio is a derived restatement of it — that editing pass took the pack's contribution from 8 to 3 rather than moving the pin by 8. The one new prose claim is the pack's Palette stating what white costs on the accent (1.97:1), a colour the pack deliberately does not ship as a token, which is the same 'evidence for a refusal' shape outrank and babylove already carry. | Raised 2026-08-24 for `nameplate`, the thirty-third pack: computed 536 -> 570 (+34), unresolved 25 (unchanged) and unguarded 27 (unchanged). The first pack in four not to move either ceiling. Its five corrections are exactly the 'evidence for a refusal' shape the three entries above document, and the difference is only in how they are written: the rejected value's hex sits on the same line as its ratio and its partner, so the gate computes the failure instead of filing it. Three claims did land unpairable on the first run and each was a line break -- 'composited over white and 1.33:1 over --field' split subject from number, and `--on-action`'s own name resolved as `--action`, which is a gradient and pairs with nothing. A fourth was a table row stating 3.69:1 with no partner named. All four were rewritten rather than pinned. | 1.48.1: computed 570 -> 572 for `nameplate`'s mark set, both ceilings unchanged. The seven new claims are glyph-on-its-own-tile ratios, each stated against the composited tile literal, which is the form the gate reads. | Raised 2026-08-24 for `rimlight`, the thirty-fourth pack: computed 572 -> 600 (+28), unresolved 25 and unguarded 27 both unchanged -- the second consecutive pack to move neither ceiling. Its --accent is the library's clearest large-text case: 3.03:1 on --bg, declared `@role non-text` because it is not BODY text, with the >= 24px exemption and the reference's own 86px usage stated at the declaration. | Raised 2026-08-25 for `onionskin`, the thirty-fifth pack: computed 600 -> 628 (+28), unresolved 25 and unguarded 27 both unchanged — the third consecutive pack to move neither ceiling. Its ratios are unusual in one way worth recording: most of them are stated for a `color-mix()` alpha rather than for a literal, because the pack's whole construction is two bases at an alpha, and the gate resolves the mix and checks them like any other pair. Five stated values were wrong on the first run and the gate supplied the right ones — all five were in the dark block, where I had computed them by hand instead of asking it.

_components_why: Measured 2026-08-20: 9 (class, pack) pairs where a `## Components` section names neither the component nor the reason the pack has none — `showroom`/cards, `roster`/inputs, `blueprint`/navigation, and loaders and empty states in `manpage`, `pigeonhole` and `roster`. The skeleton's six classes are a CONTRACT, settled by the library's own behaviour: buttons in all 23, cards in 22, inputs and navigation in 21, loaders and empty states in 19. `atrium`'s four were closed the same day by reading `functionhealth.com` again — its loader entry says NONE with the measurement behind it. This may only fall, and each fall needs its own reference read: inventing an answer is what the pack layer forbids.
_todo_container_why: 0 on 2026-08-20. It stood at 2 — `blueprint`'s registration tick and column rule, `datasheet`'s instrument cell grid — and both were resolved by doing the arithmetic the marker deferred rather than by translating 768 and 640 into `@container`. The grid already collapsed by `auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)`, so its query was deleted; the tick and the rule derive to 48px and 64px, far below anything a container reaches, which is the tell that they are ornament and belong to the page.
_scrub_why: 4 packs (blueprint, maquette, scoreboard, showroom) declare one site-wide curve, mandate scrubbed motion and carve no ease:none exception. Found 2026-08-20 while closing B-042 on instrument-console, which was the fifth and is fixed. Each carve has to be written against that pack own motion section, so the pin falls one at a time.
